scenicChapters.title: Moselle Wine Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 35 km this is Moselle Wine Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Watchtower SP 3/5* → Building remains southwest of Saalburg
scenicChapters.narrative: 36 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it. Speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

places-limessection-between-watchtowers-.story: A 277 km round trip from Höhr-Grenzhausen - roughly 4 h 47 in the saddle. The stops in between: Watchtowers WP 2/20 to 2/22, Watchtower SP 3/5*, Building remains southwest of Saalburg and Signaltower Wölferheimer Wald. The line favours views over speed.
